newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui & Co sees 21 bln yen special loss in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui & Co sees 21 bln yen special loss in 96/97.

text.p: Trading house Mitsui & Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would include an extraordinary loss of 21 billion yen in its parent earnings for the year to March 31, 1997.
The special loss, however, will not affect its earnings and dividend forecasts for the year, the company said in a statement.
The special loss is expected as a result of Mitsui's support for a leasing company in which it has a 44.8 percent stake, Mitsui said.
Mitsui said it planned to sell assets to offset the expected extraordinary loss.

Mitsui's leasing unit is planning to implement a five-year restructuring programme starting in the year from last October, and Mitsui's financial support of 21 billion yen will be a part of the programme, Mitsui said.
The programme is expected to also include a reduction in interest rates for loans extended to the unit by Sakura Bank Ltd and Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd during the five-year period, Mitsui said.
Under the programme, the unit will also continue asking other financial institutions for finacial support, Mitsui said.
